Adventurous Lofoten! Stay by the lake in Digermulen, an hour's drive from Svolvær. A brilliant starting point for exploring both Lofoten and Vesterålen with, among other things, a 24-hour grocery store, café, fuel sales and ferry connection to the island of Store-Molla.

The possibilities are many: See the Hurtigruten pass on the way to Trollfjorden, swim from the jetty, try your luck with fishing, or hike on Digermulkollen and the other mountains in the area. Visit the idyllic beaches, or just find peace and enjoy the midnight sun that reflects in Raftsundet.

The space
The property consists of a modern Nordland house with a charming annex in the garden. Here there is plenty of room for two families. The main house has two large bedrooms (double bed + double pull-out bed in both), while the annex has two bedrooms (with double beds), a private bathroom, and a sleeping loft (sleeping space for two). The place is modern and well equipped with, among other things, EV chargers ("Type 2"), Wi-Fi, washing machine, dryer, and dishwasher. Large, sunny garden, ground-level terrace, and lovely lake views. Just below is the floating dock, which is shared with nice neighbors.

We really enjoyed our stay at this house in Lofoten. The house is located in one of the most beautiful parts of Lofoten. We took the best photos right near the house on the beach. There is a great trekking route nearby called Degermulkolen, and you can take a pleasant ferry trip to the neighboring island of Store Mola. The house was very cozy and had 2.5 bathrooms, which is not often found in Lofoten. We would definitely like to come back.

We spent a week at the place in June and felt right at home from the very first minute. You could feel that the house had life and character, and the view on all sides was dominated by mountains, the sea and nature. 
We particularly enjoyed the opportunity to use an outbuilding with additional bedrooms in addition to the large house. The house is perfect if you want to travel with several friends or family. Øystein himself was also a very helpful and friendly host. We will be happy to come back!
